card.name: Words leading into feedback or messages
card.fires_on: Linking words or punctuation right after 'comments' or 'questions' in contact requests, where a message to the author or an address is expected next. Also fires on a few unrelated spots such as 'Warnings' in a cross-reference.

modes.label: Feedback invitations
modes.description: A joining word or comma after 'comments' or 'questions' in a request to write to the author.
modes.example: Send comments<< and>> suggestions to Associate Editor Megan Spencer at firstname

modes.label: Contact requests
modes.description: A verb or 'to' where the text asks the reader to contact someone or tells them to share information.
modes.example: Call parents<< to>> share both positive information and concerns.

modes.label: Cross-reference terms
modes.description: Partway through 'Warnings' in a label cross-reference.

card.writes: It suppresses message and letter words, so a message-like noun is less likely to come next.
card.plain: It fires where a sentence invites people to send comments or get in touch, just before the next word.
